verdict.rationale: Poly documents a journaling feature in which new entries are saved as Markdown files in the Mind folder. Nothing in the evidence shows a note created automatically for each day, pre-filling from a template, or a daily note acting as the default landing place. Manually created journal entries are an adjacent feature, not the daily-note capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a power-user, I get an automatic daily note for each day, pre-filled from a template, as the default landing place for journaling and capture
